reviews.review:
(7/05/2022): Months later and it gets the fine tuning! My gosh! As you can see I have been still playing this tons since I reviewed this. It's come a long way and wow, I can't get enough.

The new map really just reinvigorated my love for this game. I never really stopped playing it, as I have a routine with my friends that we play this around once a week for ♥♥♥♥♥. And the devs are as active as it gets. (Comment somewhere and they respond!) My two main takeaways now that I've really felt the game inside and out:

You really will want people to play with. It's not *nearly* as fun solo, but it could be an interesting challenge. Thankfully I almost always see a lobby open in game nowadays! If you want someone to play with leave yours open and people will hop in typically :). 

If you get good, player versus player is something else. The amount of ♥♥♥♥ talking, running each other over, drive-by-shooting. God. We roleplay the dumbest stuff and its so so fun. (And this was all on the old map!)

Cheers everyone! If it's on sale, grab it!

Original Review:

I play this too much for how scuffed it is

But it just never gets old somehow... It needs fine tuning but the idea is stellar. And I can't see to put it down.
